title: How to Fix Instagram Ad Account Disabled Reasons & Recovery Guide 2026
description:
Check out here for How to Fix Instagram Ad Account Disabled Reasons & Recovery Guide 2026.

In this video, I’m going to show you how to fix Instagram ad account disabled. If your Instagram ad account has been disabled and you want to recover it, just follow the step-by-step guide I’m about to share.

Step 1: Understand Why Your Instagram Ad Account Was Disabled
If your Instagram ad account was disabled, it’s usually due to one of the following reasons:

Violation of Instagram or Facebook’s advertising policies

Suspicious or unusual activity (like creating too many ads quickly)

Billing issues, such as expired credit cards or unpaid balances

Before you can fix the issue, it’s important to identify the cause. You can start by reviewing Instagram’s Advertising Policies to understand what might have gone wrong.

Step 2: Check Your Instagram Account Status
When your Instagram ad account gets disabled, you’ll often see a message explaining why.

To check more details:

Open Instagram

Go to your Profile

Tap the menu icon in the top-right

Go to Settings and Privacy

Tap on Account - Account Status

This section shows whether any ads or content have been flagged for violations. It’s the first place to check when learning how to fix Instagram ad account disabled.

Step 3: Appeal the Decision
If you believe the account was disabled by mistake, you can submit an appeal.

Here’s how:

Go to the Facebook Business Help Center (Instagram ads are managed through Facebook Ad Manager)

Submit a request for review of your disabled ad account

Alternatively, visit the Facebook Account Quality page to see the exact reason and request a review

Fill out the appeal form with all required details and explain why you believe the account was disabled in error

Once submitted, Facebook or Instagram will review your appeal and respond to you via email.

Final Words
So that’s how to fix Instagram ad account disabled—step by step.
By identifying the issue, checking your account status, and submitting a proper appeal, you can often recover access and get your ads back up and running.

If this video helped you, make sure to like and subscribe for more tutorials on fixing Instagram issues.

Thanks for watching, and see you in the next video!

title: How to Add a Payment Method in Hostinger for Ecommerce Store Manager 2026 Easily
description:
In today’s video, I’m going to teach you how to add a payment method in Hostinger.

Whether you’re building a brand-new website or managing a growing online store on Hostinger, connecting a payment method is essential. It’s the foundation of any functional eCommerce setup and allows you to accept payments smoothly and securely.

Let’s walk through the steps to link your payment gateway and configure your Hostinger checkout options effectively.

Step 1: Visit Hostinger and Log In
Open your browser and head over to hostinger.com. Once you’re on the homepage, click on the Login button at the top right.

Don’t have an account yet? Create one to unlock all the tools Hostinger offers for eCommerce payment setup.

Step 2: Access the hPanel Dashboard
After logging in, you’ll be redirected to hPanel, Hostinger’s easy-to-use control panel. This is where you manage everything—from hosting to domain settings and online store configurations.

Click on the Websites tab to view the sites connected to your Hostinger account.

Step 3: Go to Store Management
Find the site where you want to add a payment gateway, then click Manage Store. This brings you into the eCommerce settings section, where you can customize products, shipping, and most importantly—payment options.

Step 4: Navigate to Payment Settings
Inside the store manager, scroll or navigate to the Settings tab. Then click on Payments—the section that lets you add, edit, or remove payment methods.

Whether you're planning to connect PayPal, Stripe, or a local payment processor, Hostinger makes it simple.

Step 5: Add Your Preferred Payment Method
Once inside the payment integration panel, follow the prompts to add your desired payment gateway. Hostinger supports major services like:

PayPal

Stripe

Other local or custom gateways depending on your location

Just input your credentials or API keys, and click save.

This setup is perfect if you’re wondering how to accept payments in Hostinger, or if you're configuring your site to run as a full-featured online store.

Wrap-Up
And that’s it! You’ve now learned how to add a payment method in Hostinger using just a few simple steps.

Adding a payment method is a core part of any Hostinger eCommerce website—it helps you turn traffic into real revenue. If you’re serious about online business, mastering your payment settings is essential.

Thanks for watching!

title: How to Get Back Disappeared Candles on Tradingview, Unhide Candlesticks Easily 2026
description:
Here I will show you How to- Get it Back Disappeared Candles on Tradingview 

In today's video, I'm going to teach you how to get it back when your candles have disappeared on TradingView. If you're a regular user of TradingView for monitoring financial markets, you might encounter a situation where the candles on your chart seem to have vanished. This can be perplexing, especially if you're analyzing trends or making important trading decisions. But don't worry, I'm here to guide you through this issue smoothly and effectively.

First, head over to tradingview.com and log into your account. If you haven't signed up yet, take a moment to create an account. Once you're logged in, navigate to the chart section where you're experiencing the problem. If you've loaded your chart and notice that the candles are missing, it might initially seem like a glitch. However, there's a simple, often overlooked solution.

On the chart, look towards the right toolbar, which includes the object tree and data window—useful tools for managing and customizing your charting experience. Pay close attention to the eye icon next to the symbol's name. This icon resembles an open eye and serves as a visibility toggle for various elements on your chart. If your candles have gone missing, it's highly possible that their visibility was accidentally turned off. Simply click on this eye icon next to the symbol's name. By doing this, you reactivate the visibility of the candles on your chart, much like pulling back curtains to reveal what's behind them.

After adjusting the visibility using the eye icon, return to your chart view. You should now see the candles reappear as they were before they disappeared. This simple fix of toggling the visibility feature is often the underlying cause of this issue, and resolving it takes just a matter of seconds. This quick solution not only saves you from unnecessary frustration but also allows you to continue your trading analysis without further interruption.

Remember, TradingView offers many customizable features, and sometimes an accidental click can alter a setting like candle visibility. Always check the visibility settings if other elements seem to be missing. By understanding these basic tools and settings, you're better equipped to handle any quirks that arise during your TradingView experience.

Thank you for watching, and happy trading. If you found this video helpful, be sure to like and subscribe for more tips and tricks."
